symptom: A vNext publisher uploaded every release artifact into CAS, then failed before staged upload because the thin archive path required the legacy release-policy.json and omitted the signed vNext control-plane documents.
whyGateMissed: The agent tests uploaded complete staged trees while the CAS client test only covered a legacy staged tree, so no scenario exercised the thin archive produced by a vNext client and validated by a real agent.
earliestDetection: Stage a vNext release, send it through casput.Put to a real agent handler, and require the agent to accept the thin tree and complete a publish dry run.
